text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both up 5.8% over 24 hours while BTC dominance holds steady at 58.5%, suggesting strength is broad-based rather than concentrated in altcoins. The Fear & Greed index sits at 56 (Greed) with no weekly movement, indicating moderate bullish sentiment without euphoria. Trading volume of $118B is healthy support for the moves, though the flatness in sentiment over a week suggests conviction may be cooling despite the day's gains.
